### Universe screen (cross)

9 assets, 1990-01-02 → 2026-08-25; 5 pairs pass the correlation prefilter (≥ 0.3); 2 of them reject the Engle-Granger null at 5%. With 36 candidate pairs, ≈ 2 would pass at 5% by pure chance (Clegg 2014), so this screen is *descriptive*: performance claims come only from the walk-forward section below.
